sources.title: HKSAR Government press release, 14 May 2026: Results of final winners of Content Development Scheme for Streaming Platforms announced (issued for the FDC)
sources.said: Four final winners of the Content Development Scheme for Streaming Platforms under the Film Development Fund (FDF) have been selected. Each winner will receive a maximum of $4.5 million for the production of a pilot of their streaming series. … The Scheme, having received over 50 eligible applications, recruited participating teams through a competition to develop content for a series for streaming platforms. Among the applications, 10 projects were shortlisted, and each received a script development fee of $600,000 to $1.2 million to develop a full production proposal and scripts of an entire series. The final four winners out of the 10 shortlisted projects each receive a maximum of $4.5 million to produce a pilot of the series to identify potential platform investors. Together with the script development fee, each final winning team is awarded a total of up to $5.7 million.

sources.title: FDC: Content Development Scheme for Streaming Platforms – Guide to Application
sources.said: 4.1 … (b) each and every producer, director, script supervisor and scriptwriter must be a permanent resident of Hong Kong aged eighteen (18) years or above; … 4.2 The proposed mini-series (“Mini-series”) shall have at least six (6) episodes, with the running time of each episode of at least forty-five (45) minutes. It shall be a fictional narrative (animated series and docuseries not included). … 6.3.3 … ten (10) Applications as Phase 2 projects … will receive a cash prize of a minimum of $600,000 for a six (6)-episode Mini-series, with $100,000 for each episode from the 7th episode up to $1,200,000 being the maximum amount … 6.4.2 … not more than four (4) Mini-series (“Phase 3 Projects”) will be selected. … will receive a cash prize of $4.5 million for producing the Pilot Episodes. … the cash prize shall only be used for production of the Pilot Episodes and shall not cover any other expenses such as promotion and marketing, distribution etc. … 6.5.5 … it can of its own volition seek funding from other investors, financiers and/or streaming platform operators to finance the production of the remaining episodes of the Mini-series. Unless with the approval of the Government, the completed entire series can only be released on streaming platforms which are on the list of streaming platforms to be specified by the Government from time to time and are available to viewers in Hong Kong within the first three (3) years upon the completion of the Pilot Episodes. If the Selected Phase 2 Company secures funding to finance the completion of the entire Mini-series, the entire series shall only be available on streaming platforms on a subscription basis in the first year of release.

sources.title: Hong Kong Arts Development Council: Project Grant
sources.said: Project Grant mainly supports music, dance, drama, Xiqu, visual arts, film and media arts ... Individual applicant - Individual artists who hold a Hong Kong identity card are eligible to apply as individuals. He/she must have reached the age of 18 at the time of application. Organisation applicant - Organisations that are registered and conducting arts activities in Hong Kong are eligible as applicants. ... Applications will be processed only if sufficient evidence is provided to prove that the arts project is non-profit making. ... For grants under $100,000, Project Report and original receipts must be submitted within 3 months of project completion

sources.title: HKADC: Drama and Multi-Disciplinary Arts Project Grant Assessment Guidelines (valid for applications 1 July 2025 to 31 December 2026)
sources.said: 3 The proposed project must take place in Hong Kong with Hong Kong residents as the target audience. … 5 Grant Amount a) Due to resource constraints, HKADC is only able to support grant applications on a selective basis and may not be able to award the full amount sought by the applicant. … d) In general, the maximum grant for each approved Project Grant application is $700,000 (except for “Drama Artistic Creation Experiment and Research Scheme” and “Playwriting” applications. … A. Performance … 3 Guidelines on Income and Expenditure a) Estimated box office income should be calculated by an attendance of 60% of the total available seating capacity for ticket sales. Average ticket price should not be less than $70. b) Meal allowances is limited to no more than $80 per person per formal rehearsal/performance/dismantling day, subject to a ceiling of $8,000. … v. The grant ceiling of these applications is $200,000. … C. Playwriting … d) … The maximum grant for each project shall not exceed $140,000.
